thesis: The page is a test strip: every section is a pad that reads a value against its ideal band, and the signature is the gauge scale that fills as you scroll.

signature.name: Gauge Scale + Test Pad
signature.summary: Horizontal scale with shaded ideal band and marker showing where 'this' sits; section dividers are blank test-pad rectangles that fill with color on entry. Reused in hero (six pads), services (mini-gauges), proof (star/price gauges), and footer (weekly range gauge). Hook: data-sw-signature='gauge-scale'.

palette.family: Paper White + Forest Teal + Ink Navy

motion.intro: Six test pads fade from white to sample colors in sequence (stagger 80ms); markers slide into ideal bands simultaneously. Skippable; reduced motion shows completed state.
stories: Service card gauge markers slide from left edge to position on entry (clip-path wipe, 600ms, ease-out)
Review star and price-range markers animate into position; section-divider test pads fill with color via clip-path wipe
motion.hover: Gauge marker pulses once (scale 1.0→1.15→1.0, 200ms) on hover of any interactive gauge or card
